parent: Phase-28 context-only 26-vs-62 MDL selector PASS, 57/57 across wave, Gray-Scott, NLS, advection, and Burgers
question: Does the frozen Phase-28 selector transfer to a sixth unseen law whose dynamics require quadratic products of spatial derivatives, which are absent from both candidate libraries?

new_family.name: two_component_viscous_hamilton_jacobi_2d
new_family.discrete_update: For each channel z independently: dz/dt = nu*Laplacian(z) - 0.5*lambda*((Dx z)^2 + (Dy z)^2), using centered periodic finite differences and four Euler substeps per observed frame.

primary_model.selector: BIC-like held-out score N*log(validation_MSE+1e-12)+K*log(N); ties choose base26
primary_model.recursive_projection: unchanged Phase-10 18-bit companded token projection after every step

secondary_diagnostic.name: odd_spatial_quadratic82
secondary_diagnostic.construction: interaction62 plus, separately for each physical channel, all 10 unique degree-2 products among the four parity-odd 3x3 real-Fourier spatial coordinates {sin_x, sin_y, sin_diag_plus, sin_diag_minus}; 20 added features total
secondary_diagnostic.purpose: Test whether any primary failure is caused by missing spatial-gradient quadratic terms rather than token-state capacity. Report raw one-step and token recursive rollout. Cannot rescue or redefine Phase-29 gate.

primary_rule: PASS only if the unchanged Phase-28 context selector beats raw-state persistence on all four Hamilton-Jacobi tests in all three fresh registered replicates (12/12 cells). Any selected ratio >=1.0 is Phase-29 FAIL. No retries or replacement seeds.
diagnostic_interpretation: If primary fails while raw/token 82-feature diagnostics succeed, interpret as candidate-hypothesis-class insufficiency, not as evidence that the tokenizer cannot encode the state. Diagnostic success cannot convert Phase-29 into PASS.
failure_policy: All registered outcomes retained. No posthoc candidate addition, selector penalty change, ridge change, context change, simulator-range change, or seed replacement.
next_if_primary_fail_and_82_succeeds: A separate preregistered phase may promote the 82-feature spatial-quadratic library as a third candidate in context-only complexity selection and must re-test all six families.
claim_limit: Known synthetic dynamics only; not new physics or unrestricted scientific-law discovery.
